remarks: COMING SOON | HOLLYWOOD RIVIERA. Perched on a gentle knoll with picturesque views of the Palos Verdes Peninsula, this beautifully maintained 1954 residence blends timeless elegance, thoughtful updates, and classic vintage charm. Featuring 2 generously sized bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, beautiful hardwood floors, vaulted ceilings, and inviting living spaces connected by a double-sided fireplace. The spacious kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, a charming vintage range, and a nearly new Sub-Zero refrigerator.
